user.title: Connect to Imou Open Platform
user.description: Enter the App ID and App Secret of your application on open.imoulife.com (Console > My App > Application Information) and pick the data center shown there.

device.title: Choose your robot
device.description: Select the robot vacuum. If the list is empty, type its serial number (printed on the robot / shown in the Imou Life app).

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Your App ID or App Secret is no longer accepted.

error.invalid_auth: App ID or App Secret not accepted. Check them and the data center.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Imou cloud.

abort.already_configured: This robot is already set up.

init.title: Update speed
init.description: Imou allows 30,000 free API calls per month. Updating every 120 s when idle and every 30 s while cleaning stays within that.

dump.name: Dump device info
dump.description: Write device details and thing model to the Home Assistant log.

read_properties.name: Read properties
read_properties.description: Write raw property values to the log.

set_properties.name: Set properties
set_properties.description: Write raw property values to the robot.

properties.name: Properties
properties.description: Mapping of property number to value.
